terminals.summary: Perspective metric depth and current/past raw LiDAR both recovered 0/9 dropout windows because the frozen matcher had no admissible closing signal; this is not a metric-depth or LiDAR negative.
terminals.successor_requires: An independent causal spatiotemporal occupancy-flow signal with evaluator identity excluded from temporal association.
forbidden_repeats: depth-backbone swap on the consumed cohort

terminals.summary: Causal raw-LiDAR occupancy flow recovered 9/9 induced windows and 3/3 critical events, proving an independent spatiotemporal signal exists, but false segments rose 12 to 20 and one-to-one event F1 remained 22.22%.
terminals.successor_requires: A different motion information source or a separately frozen fresh protocol.
forbidden_repeats: attribution/tube/lifecycle tuning on the opened cohort

terminals.summary: On consumed video17, set-valued belief preserved 100% navigation precision and increased coverage from 73.45% to 81.42%; exact-instance identity was not evaluable because each public goal mapped to multiple physical IDs without a public instance reference.
terminals.successor_requires: A legal public exact-instance authority source rather than matcher tuning.
forbidden_repeats: treating set-valued navigation as exact-instance success

terminals.summary: On fresh source-disjoint video18, legal public instance binding plus temporal belief achieved 100% precision, 91.67% coverage, zero wrong-instance frames/switches, and 6/6 gap reacquisition/end-to-end episodes.
terminals.successor_requires: A new claim layer and separately authorized evidence; the replay result itself cannot establish active observation, arrival, product, user, or safety effects.
forbidden_repeats: using evaluator physical IDs at inference
promoting replay evidence to product or safety

terminals.summary: Fixed three-view appearance increased PRESERVE bias, collapsed Doorway FLIP to 0/24 in both seeds, and left owner-group macro balanced accuracy near chance.
terminals.successor_requires: A genuinely new information source or representation under a new versioned protocol.

terminals.summary: Frame-level MSLS GPS was admitted, but the frozen router underperformed static fusion and collapsed toward GPS; source admission did not establish routing benefit.
terminals.successor_requires: A new representation or fresh cohort; do not rescue the consumed router cohort.
